parsed.explanation: Positives: no trans criminalisation; an entry-side pride-welcome programme easing passport/appearance scrutiny; documented social acceptance ahead of law; mature gender-affirming care; no documented police targeting of trans visitors; LGBT prison separation since 1993 and a dedicated remand block. Negatives: no legal gender recognition (resident-side, but leaves documents mismatched in everyday checks); custody placement turns on a doctor's verification, with non-medically-transitioned trans women usually facing men's cells or solitary and documented intake harassment — a state-imposed exposure with no shown individual-assessment remedy; one hospital ward refusal; no hate-crime designation and a documented accountability gap (Nov 2025) after a 2025 killing; equality-statute enforcement assessed as spotty. Single incident, thin visitor detention data. Net: acceptance plus partial entry protection, offset by unresolved custody and remedy gaps.
